content.comment_body: Hi, I recently acquired an older [product_name] 230 RC [article_no]. I wanted to program it like my other [article_no] units. The program was ready, but I couldn't transfer it because [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] only allows 3 inputs for a [article_no], even though 6 are physically present. According to [company_name] documentation, 6 inputs should be available. [url] How can I use all 6 inputs?

Hello [user_name], That should work. Try pressing F2 in your program and check in the status window if you have all inputs already assigned somewhere. It works for me without any problem. You can also post your program—I'll take a look at it. Regards

Closed because the question has also been posted in the German language conferences. You can find it under the subject 'Wie kann ich alle 6 Eingänge bei meiner [product_name] 230 RC [article_no] nutzen?' in the conference for logic modules. analysis.insight_summary: The user's main concern involves a limitation in [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], which only allows the use of 3 inputs on the [product_name] 230 RC [article_no] module, even though the hardware supports 6. Confusion arises because [company_name] documentation claims all 6 inputs should be accessible, but the software imposes a restriction. Another user mentions that all 6 inputs should be usable, increasing uncertainty about whether the issue is technical or a software limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] to support and enable use of all 6 physical inputs on the [product_name] 230 RC [article_no], as promised in [company_name] documentation.
